claims: According to reports and industry insiders, Sadie Sink is set to join the Marvel Cinematic Universe in Spider-Man: Brand New Day (working title) as a key character.
The key character is widely reported to be Jean Grey.
Multiple sources indicate Sadie Sink is playing Jean Grey.
The casting reportedly involved Marvel Studios President Kevin Feige.
Reports indicate Sadie Sink is heavily involved in the plot of the upcoming Spider-Man film.
